articleTitle: Elderly Motion Tracking System with AI-Enabled Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of technology, the intersection of edge computing with health care holds immense promise, especially in addressing the needs of vulnerable populations such as the elderly. This research focuses on developing a motion detection system using advanced technologies like artificial intelligence and edge computing to integrate with real-time database systems. This system is developed not only to monitor activities but also to analyze activity patterns in the elderly. These patterns have the potential to identify diseases early, preventing unforeseen consequences. Our evaluation analyzes the accuracy of detecting standing and sleeping positions. It demonstrates high precision in identifying standing postures but reveals challenges in recognizing sleeping postures, mainly due to tracking and detection issues in the YOLOv8 model.

articleTitle: A Study on Sino-Thai Cross-Border E-Commerce Talent Cultivation Standard Base on Competency Gap Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The “Belt and Road” Initiative (BRI) and the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Framework have facilitated trade between China and Thailand, particularly in cross-border ecommerce (CBEC), which has shown strong development momentum. However, the lack of cross-border e-commerce talent cultivation aggravated the talent gap and obstructed industry development in Thailand. This paper, applying CBEC SMEs in Northern Thailand as a case study, explores the required competencies of employees as criteria for CBEC talent cultivation. This research addresses the talent shortage as a critical bottleneck of the CBEC industry, particularly those who possess e-commerce business capacity with multi-lingual ability. It seeks to establish a KSAO-based competency model to meet the recruitment requirements of China-Thai CBEC SMEs.

articleTitle: A Method of Hand Segmentation by Integrated Image Processing Techniques for Touchless-Controlled Image Viewer in an Operating Room
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Sterilization condition in the surgical units is important. Contamination problems regards to infection rate after surgery. The computer workstation is always used for x-ray image viewer. To avoid the contamination problem, we proposed a method of hand segmentation using integrated image processing technique. This is important step to develop a touchless system to control image viewer in an operating room. The method consists of three steps: 1) hand localization, 2) hand detection, and 3) hand segmentation. Hand localization is to use multiple image processing technique for preliminary detecting the hand location. The edge of object inside the hand location is used to define the bounding box in hand detection step. Finally, the hand segmentation is to fill the blank pixel in the hand area. To evaluate the proposed method, data of nine subjects was used. Segmentation precision is measured by the Intersection over Union (IoU) threshold and the detection rate. The detection rate is 100%. The experiment shows satisfactory result.

articleTitle: Usability study of mobile healthcare application for the elderly
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Various healthcare services and mobile applications tailored for the elderly have surfaced, yet studies related to UI design and usability do not significantly differ from those targeting the general public. Consequently, general healthcare services pose inconveniences and difficulties for elderly users, resulting in a multitude of operational errors. Hence, the primary objective of this study is to evaluate usability with the aim of enhancing mobile applications that are elderly-friendly. By comparing usability evaluation results before and after improvements to the healthcare application, design elements influencing the usability of elderly-friendly applications were identified. The usability evaluation was broadly categorized into an objective evaluation based on a performance matrix and a subjective evaluation employing the System Usability Scale (SUS). The findings of this study validate that providing assistance, increasing font size, introducing sound feedback, and incorporating a preparatory phase to enhance elderly users’ cognition significantly contribute to overall usability improvements for the elderly. These research outcomes are expected to be applied in the future development of diverse applications and service research specifically tailored to the elderly.

articleTitle: A Hybrid SARIMAX Model in Conjunction with Neural Networks for the Forecasting of Life Insurance Industry Growth in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This article is conducted with the primary aim of comparing various forecasting models to identify the optimal model for forecasting the growth of the life insurance industry in Thailand. The models under consideration include the SARIMAX model, the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and a hybrid model introduced as RNN-SARIMAX. The dataset utilized for this investigation is extensive, consisting of monthly direct premium data from the Thai life insurance sector spanning January 2003 to December 2022. The dataset is segregated into two distinct segments. Initially, data from January 2003 to December 2021 is employed for constructing the forecasting model. Subsequently, data from January 2022 to December 2022 is utilized for a comparative analysis of the forecasting models, to determine the most suitable and accurate model for predicting the growth of the life insurance industry in Thailand. The evaluation criteria for comparing models include the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and the Coefficient of Determination (R-squared). The consistent findings from our analysis indicate that the SARIMAX model consistently outperforms both the RNN and RNN-SARIMAX models.

articleTitle: Development of a Capacitive Sensing Module to Detect the Concentration of Isopropyl Alcohol for Covid-19 Disinfection Using Small Capacitance to DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a sensing module for analyzing the concentration of disinfectant alcohol commercially available in Thailand during the Covid-19 epidemic situation to ensure the ingredients and percentage concentration by focusing on simplicity, low cost with reliable performance. Under the basic physical structure of the capacitance change [1]–[5], it consists of a New Sensor Module developed to fully interface with the small capacitance to DC converter for capacitive sensor [2] model. Inside the sensing structure, there were 2 modules of metal conductors. Each conductor was 3 mm. thick, placed in parallel with a fixed distance between the module of 1 mm. The cross-sectional areas of the plates of those two modules were different in order to compare the efficiency of the detector developed. The cross-sectional areas of the plates of Module A and B were 4 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. Experiments were performed with 3 concentrations of alcohol, 65%, 70% and 75%, to enhance the concentration detecting performance of the sensing module developed. The signal conditioning was generated from a small capacitance to DC converter for capacitive detection with a frequency of 100 kHz, which was the most suitable frequency for exciting the capacitance change which was the capacitive reactance of the alcohol used in this study. From experiments, it was found that the sensing module with a small cross-sectional conductive material would provide more accurate results in terms of linearity and repeatability. The errors were less than 2.72% compared to the module with a large cross-sectional conductor material which would have an error up to 4.73%.

articleTitle: Bridging Gaps in Elementary English Classroom Management: A Gamification Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study addresses the challenges of second language classroom management, specifically focusing on new teachers in elementary English classes. Classroom disruption poses a significant challenge impacting instruction and management, particularly for new teachers. Exploring the excitement and challenges of learning English as a Second Language and acknowledging the significance of active student participation, findings reveal gaps in ineffective classroom management strategies, insufficient positive behavior encouragement, and inadequate addressing of negative behaviors. The paper introduces a qualitative research design, utilizing purposive sampling and classroom observation. The paper proposes a gamification conceptual framework as a transformative solution for effective classroom management, validated through expert reviews, demonstrating the quantification of engagement and behavioral improvements. The study emphasizes the potential impact of gamified classroom management on student learning.

articleTitle: A Method for De-Identification Analysis of Encrypted Video
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: As the variety of video content increases, so does the likelihood of data breaches of sensitive personal information. Consequently, several video de-identification techniques have been developed to protect personal data, alongside ongoing research into video encryption technology, which offers the advantage of decryption to obtain the original video without storing a separate video copy. While it is possible to visually evaluate whether individual encrypted frames have been correctly de-identified, human interpretation makes this method vulnerable to subjective bias. Many video encryption studies employ traditional image quality evaluation metrics, such as peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity index measure (SSIM), to objectively demonstrate the de-identification of encrypted videos. However, these metrics prove to be insufficiently effective for this purpose. These image metrics can measure the de-identification rate of a single frame in encrypted videos, but not the entire video. This study introduces a quantitative analysis method to confirm de-identification in fully encrypted videos. In this study, we measured the de-identification rates of all frames of encrypted videos using a weighted sum of SSIM and edge differential ratio. We also measured the de-identification rate of a fully encrypted video. Finally, we graphically analyzed these data using line charts. This objective methodology enabled the identification of portions of the encrypted video where de-identification techniques may not have been appropriately applied.

articleTitle: The Development of Online Games for Public Relations Media Promoting Tourism in Chiang Rai Province
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research aims to 1) Study Chiang Rai’s tourism public relations media 2) Create media to publicize tourism in Chiang Rai in the form of a game and 3) Evaluate the efficiency and satisfaction of online game users. The researcher selected 9 important tourist attractions in Chiang Rai through an assessment form from 3 experts, consisting of 1) Chiang Rai tourism-related experts, 2) graphic design experts, and 3) programming experts. The researcher designed the graphic design of the character with the scene consisting of the technique of drawing tourist attractions in conjunction with the Construct 2 program. Public relations media is a twodimensional game that looks like a level adventure game with a narrative presenting the main attractions of Chiang Rai province. All three experts evaluated the game’s performance with an agree level average ($\bar{x}=4.43$, S.D. $=0.73$). After offered the game to 20 volunteer tourists to play. The game’s performance has been evaluated with the strongly agree level average $(\bar{x}=4.55$, S.D. $=0.55)$ and the average satisfaction at the agree level $(\bar{x}=4.44$, S.D. $=0.65)$.

articleTitle: Drug image classification with deep learning by using Fast Region-based Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: At present, there are many drugs produced for the treatment of various diseases. The most often registered drug formulations, according to statistics on drug formulation registration, were pills. Some pills have remarkably similar outward appearances, despite not being the same type, as may be observed. This makes it challenging for those without medical knowledge to categorize pills as drugs of any kind. Deep learning is a machine learning approach that is being applied in a variety of applications, including image classification, image analysis, and object recognition. In the context of identifying drug images, computer vision algorithms can be trained to recognize various characteristics such as color, shape, markings, and packaging of different drugs. This can be particularly useful in various domains such as healthcare, law enforcement, and pharmaceuticals. This paper proposes a drug image classification by using Fast Region-base convolution neural network (Fast R-CNN). Convolution layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers are some of the building blocks that CNN employs to automatically and adaptively learn spatial hierarchies of input through backpropagation. A region-based strategy is used in this paper to reduce the detection time. Experiments have shown that our proposed framework can accurately identify different types of 20 drugs with over 98 percent accuracy.

articleTitle: An AI-Based Growth Assessment of Green Oak Leaf Lettuce via LINE Chatbot for Amateur Growers: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Systems with automated recommendations are widely used in many mobile applications, such as e-commerce, news, agriculture, and other fields. Agricultural information is an essential driving force for the development of agricultural modernization. The goal of this work was to assist amateur green oak leaf lettuce growers, who do not have access to the assistance of agricultural experts. The growers are required to capture a photo of the crops and send it through the LINE application. The image will then be processed to assess the stages of growth and in addition, a set of chosen advice will be given through a response message. This process is a very economical approach that allows growers with little technical knowledge to use this system through the well-known LINE chatbot. In this investigation, YOLO, a powerful object detection algorithm, was employed for estimating lettuce growth. The recommendations were prepared to support the growth assessment along with the LINE bot platform. The implementation performed well according to the design and functional process flow. Although the average assessment accuracy reached 90% in this preliminary study, future work needs more investigation into various aspects.

articleTitle: Mobile health applications for monitoring children’s oral health at school
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper aims to development of an information system tailored for the management of individual oral health examination data among primary school children in Thailand’s Kuantan district. The study employs the Research and Development (R&D) methodology, comprising three phases. In phase 1, a comprehensive situation analysis is conducted through documentary reviews and group discussions. Phase 2 focuses on the development of a prototype information system, aligning with Agile development principles. Finally, in phase 3, the application is implemented, and its feasibility is assessed through the administration of a questionnaire. The study’s findings highlight the critical features required for the system, including data export capabilities to the Health Data Center (HDC) database, the generation of summarized examination results, streamlined appointment scheduling, comprehensive analysis at both the school and district levels, versatile data export formats, and user-friendly data entry options. The questionnaire results underscore high levels of satisfaction with the system’s efficiency improvement and its provision of detailed summary reports. Future research endeavors should explore a larger population to further validate and enhance the system’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: LSEG: Lung Segmentation for Pulmonary Disease Affected Chest Radiographs
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Approximately four million people die due to lung diseases. A shortfall of 42% pulmonologists is estimated by 2030. This is an indication of overburden on the pulmonologists and delay in pulmonary disease diagnosis. Computer vision-based tools may prove useful in addressing these challenges by assisting health experts in the primary screening of lung abnormalities. However, the extraction of irrelevant features may degrade the reliability of these techniques. This raises the need for employing pre-processing techniques. Many researchers employed lung segmentation techniques for the preprocessing of chest radiographs. These techniques lack in identifying soft tissues and lung boundaries from chest radiographs of infected people. This is due to an increase in opacity due to lung infection or abnormality. In this manuscript, the authors focus on recognizing soft tissues and boundaries even in infected radiographs. They propose a lung segmentation model (LSEG) that utilizes spatial and reverse attention layers for discarding irrelevant features and extracting relevant features. It employs a loss function derived using binary cross entropy, mixed gradient, and intersection-over-union loss functions. This enables LSEG to locate the structural pattern of the lungs in the chest radiographs. The model achieves the highest accuracy of 97.12% on the testing dataset and outperforms other segmentation architectures such as U-Net, U-Net++, Pyramid Scene Parsing Network, and Fully Convolutional Network.

articleTitle: A Study on the Methodology of Online Conference to Enhance Interpersonal Communication and Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The essence of an online conference is to facilitate communication and interaction in real-time through the Internet platform, employing new technologies, methods, and formats to enhance the communication experience and emotional engagement for both online audiences and speakers. Drawing on the theory of symbolic interactionism, this paper analyzes the issues related to interpersonal communication and interaction in online conferences, and proposes the incorporation of interactive elements, strengthening the sense of hierarchy within the virtual meeting space, adopting flexible contextual switches for interactions. These measures aim to enhance communication and interaction during online meetings, provide the audience with a more engaging participation experience, and ultimately improve the overall impact of holding online conferences.

articleTitle: Monitoring System for Hospitalized COVID-19 Patients in Tertiary Care Hospital, Chiang Mai
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: COVID-19 is an epidemic with widespread impacts worldwide. As service providers or patient caregivers, obtaining accurate information is crucial for providing effective care, treatment, and continuous monitoring of the patient’s condition. This research aims to study and develop the platform with monitoring potential long-term effects, particularly long COVID symptoms, necessitating ongoing vigilance. This is especially important for patients with chronic diseases or a history thereof, as new adverse symptoms may arise. The systematic storage and high-quality data provided by the CMC-19 program play a pivotal role in ensuring the success and reliability of this research study. This data enables thorough analysis for care and treatment, as well as continuous follow-up on patients.

articleTitle: Thai Herbs Recommendation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This work proposes a Thai herbs recommendation model to recommend appropriate Thai herbs to users. Herbs data was collected from available data sources including books, websites, and publication documents. All data were integrated, cleaned, and transformed before transfer to the herbs database. The rule-based was produced based on herbs properties for various symptoms. Then, the best Thai herbs were given based on the specific condition of the user. The overall model evaluation was compared with solutions from the National List of Essential Drugs A.D. 1999 (List of herbal medicine products) given 0.77 precision, 1.00 recall, and 0.87 F-measure.

articleTitle: Green Peafowl Detection System for Paddy Field Value Creation in Phayao Area
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Green peafowl is classified as protected wildlife of the Wildlife Preservation and Protection Act Thailand and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). The green peafowl can be found in Phayao area considered as the stronghold of the green peafowl. However, farmers, who have paddy fields located nearby the forest patch where the peafowl lives, currently suffer with the peafowl eating their agricultural products. This results in lower yields and lower incomes. To support sustainable coexistence between communities and peafowl, and promote a circular economy in the area, this paper proposes green peafowl detection system for paddy field value creation in Phayao area. The system is available to detect the green peafowls using camera modules that can be stored and manage data sending schedule online. The system is designed to be able to set and view videos of the green peafowl behavior via web application. Therefore, it can be used as a tool building trust between farmers and customers efficiently.

articleTitle: Digital Illustration Designs of Lanna Local Foods for Use in Creative Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The aims of this research are as follows: 1) to investigate the food culture of the Lanna people and Lanna local foods; 2) to design digital illustrations of Lanna local foods for application to use in creative works; 3) to evaluate the efficiency of utilizing digital illustrations of Lanna local foods in creative works. The research methodology was performed by studying the information in documented information and field data relating to the food culture and the existence of Lanna local foods. Furthermore, the research methodology consisted of analyzing artistic styles, design, and evaluating the efficiency of ready-made illustrations of Lanna local foods. The evaluation was conducted by 3 experts in graphic design and digital illustrations, along with the participation of 50 individuals, including students from the Graphic Design Program and graphic designers in Chiang Rai Province. The findings indicated that the Lanna local food designs could be categorized into 17 types: 1) curry (Kaeng), 2) roasted foods (Kao), 3) simmered foods (Khio), 4) sour soup (JOR), 5) Omelet (Jeaw), 6) pounded/mixed foods (Tam/Yam), 7) chili pastes (Nam prik), 8) steamed foods (Neung), 9) grilled/fried foods (yaang/Tod), 10) curry with squeezed crab juice or curry with local vegetables and herbs (Mob), 11) uncooked food (Larb/Lu), 12) mix vegetable or raw meat spicey salad (SAR), 13) fermented foods (mak/dong), 14) mixed foods, pickled foods, wrapping food in banana leaves and cooking in a pot or pan (Ok), 15) meat simmered on low heat (Uk/Hum), 16) wrapping food in banana leaves and grilling (Ab), and 17) dessert/snacks, totaling 127 menus. The researcher and experts studied and analyzed the features, and then designed illustrations. The results were web-based publications, digital media, calendar design, public relations media, souvenir products, and a picture book showcasing Lanna foods. Regarding the evaluation results on the efficiency of the use of ready-made illustrations of Lanna local foods and a picture book of Lanna foods, the identity area was at the highest level ($\overline{\mathrm{x}}=4.54$, S.D.=0.69); the beauty area was at the highest level ($\overline{\mathrm{X}}=4.59$, S.D. $=0.64$); the functionality area was at the highest level ($\overline{\mathrm{X}}=4.63$, S.D. $=0.59$)

articleTitle: Mobile assessment for the evaluation of media and alcohol consumption behaviors among communities in tourist districts
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: According to a survey conducted in the region, the northern region has the highest percentage of drinkers in the country, accounting for 33 percent of the population. Consequently, frequent celebratory imbibing occurs during particular festivals and festivities. In addition, as a result of the environment and landscape, residents frequently decide for celebrations as an opportunity to strengthen relationships with each other. Therefore, the objective of this research is to explore the effectiveness of the media in promoting abstinence from alcohol during Buddhist Lent and the behaviour of community members prior to and following Buddhist Lent, with a particular emphasis on tourist-rich regions. The research study is an area-based quasi-experimental study with mobile technology evaluation. This paper show mobile technology enables the creation of adaptive assessments that adjust difficulty levels based on users’ responses, providing a more personalized, comparative and accurate evaluation.

articleTitle: Attendance Checking-Based On-Device Multiple Face Recognition using Flutter Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Biometric class attendance systems have recently been developed to increase accuracy and efficiency, with facial recognition a popular choice. Currently, facial recognition mobile applications can recognize one student per frame, which is not appropriate for classes with vast numbers of students. This paper proposed a student attendance mobile application implemented on the Flutter platform. Facial detection was achieved using the Firebase ML kit, with multiple-facial recognition performed by a deep neural network (DNN) model that applied transfer learning using the fine-tuned ResNet-50 and VGGFace2 datasets.Facial images of 25 students were assessed, with results giving 0.95 precision, 0.875 recall, 0.91 F-measure, 0.91 accuracy, and 24.5 seconds processing time. The proposed mobile application was then deployed as a smaller model, giving precision, recall, F-measure, and accuracy similar to the baseline model but with reduced computational time.

articleTitle: The Design of Himmapan Animal Illustrations in Super Deformed (SD) Style for Using in New Media
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research aimed to design the illustrations of Himmapan animals in Super Deformed (SD) form for application to new media and to evaluate the suitability of designing the illustrations of Himmapan animals in SD form for application to new media. This research employed a mixed method, starting with qualitative research to analyze data for use in designing the illustrations of Himmapan animals in SD form and then conducting quantitative research to determine the suitability of designing the illustrations of Himmapan animals in SD form. The illustration design of Himmapan animals were divided into three types: bipedal animals, four-legged animals, and aquatic animals. Each type consisted of three kinds of animals. That is, bipedal animals included swan, Hasadee Link bird, and Kinnaree. Four-legged animals included Singha, Mom, and Kochasri. Aquatic animals included Machawan, Naga, and mermaid. The results of this research showed that the design of Himmapan animal illustrations in SD style for application to new media, conveying the uniqueness of Himmapan animals, and conveying value and applying to new media and design according to the characteristics of SD illustrations were at the highest level. The results of this research can be applied to the design of illustrations of Himmapan animals for use in new media. It can also be applied as a guideline for the development for use as a public relations media and commercial products. Moreover, they can be used on online platforms in order to create contemporary awareness of arts and culture.

articleTitle: Smart UV Analyzer for Pesticide Residues Detection Using TLC Based On Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the smart UV analyzer for pesticide residues detection using Thin-layer Chromatography (TLC) based on image processing. The proposed method aims to reduce the time-consuming of the conventional method that uses an ordinary UV analyzer. Meanwhile, the proposed method requires no specialist staff and can avoid harmful UV radiation from an ordinary UV Analyzer. The smart UV analyzer consists of 3 components: an inserting component, an I/O component, and a processor component, including an image processing program used to calculate the rate of flow (Rf) and identify the type of pesticide residue. In the experimental setting, 30 samples of vegetables were investigated. The experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce time consumption by 3.98 times per sample compared with the conventional method on average.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Yagi-Uda Antenna via Meta- Hybrid Intensified Current Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This article proposes the optimal design of the Yagi-Uda antenna by using the meta-hybrid intensified current search (MHICuS) algorithm, which is one of the novel powerful metaheuristic optimization techniques. Based on the modern optimization, the objective of this optimization is to maximize the antenna's directivity by searching for the optimal lengths and distances between elements of the YagiUda antenna array. Results obtained by the MHICuS are compared with those obtained by other metaheuristic optimization techniques appeared in literatures. As simulation results, the six-element Yagi-Uda antenna is optimally designed by the proposed MHICuS and yields greater directivity than other exist optimization techniques in literatures, satisfactorily.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Engagement and Interaction in Library Automation through Gamification
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research investigates the integration of gamification into library automation systems, focusing on the Angkeaw Library Automation. The study employs a mixed- methods approach, combining quantitative metrics and qualitative insights to evaluate the impact of gamification on user engagement and satisfaction. Utilizing a comparative analysis, the research compares the usage patterns of a standard library automation system with a gamified counterpart over a three-month period. Initial findings reveal that the gamified system attracts higher user engagement initially, but experiences a notable decline over time, raising questions about the sustained impact of gamification. The standard automation system, in contrast, exhibits a modest rebound in usage. The results suggest that while gamification can effectively enhance short-term engagement, careful consideration is needed to ensure its long-term effectiveness. The research concludes by emphasizing the need for periodic reassessment and innovation in gamification strategies to maintain sustained user interest in library automation systems.

articleTitle: White Light Photodetection Using Vertical ZnO/CuO Heterostructure Nanowires
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Vertically aligned axial ZnO/CuO heterostructure (HS) nanowires (NWs) were grown using sputtering integrated with glancing angle deposition (GLAD) technique. Field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) images confirmed the growth of vertically aligned axial ZnO/CuO HS NWs. Furthermore, post-annealing treatment at varying temperatures like 300°C, 400°C and 500°C was performed on the samples in order to study the effect of temperature on the structural, optical and electrical characteristics of the samples. On fabricating photodetectors, the 400°C annealed axial ZnO/CuO HS NWs sample showed the best performance in terms of faster photoresponse (response time (${\mathrm {t}}_{\text{rise}}=0.21 \mathrm{~ms}$ and $t_{\text{fall}}=0.20 \mathrm{~ms}$ at +5V under white light illumination)) due to minimum defect density, enhancement in crystallinity (as established from X-ray diffraction and photoluminescence analyses respectively) in addition to efficiently separated photocarrier generation. This signified that post-treatment on the axial ZnO/CuO HS NWs have attractive scope for photodetector application.

articleTitle: A Sensor-Based Deep Learning Approach for Recognizing Daily and Work Activities in Open Environments for Sanitation Workers
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Sanitation workers play a crucial role in maintaining public hygiene and cleanliness. Understanding their daily routines and job responsibilities is essential for improving their work environment, task distribution, and overall supervision. However, tracking sanitation workers in open environments remains a persistent challenge. This paper introduces a deep learning model named CNN-BiGRU-CBAM, designed to recognize sanitation workers’ daily and working activities using smartwatch sensors. The model leverages advanced convolutional neural networks to extract highly informative features from multi-modal sensor data, including acceleration information, collected from smartwatches. The dataset used in this study is carefully curated and collected from sanitation workers during their daily work routines, encompassing activities such as walking, running, sweeping, lifting, and driving vehicles. These activities are systematically categorized to cover both work-related tasks and non-work activities. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model consistently achieves an average F1-score of over 94.50% across seven activity groups, outperforming baseline deep learning methods by an impressive margin of 5.62%. The model excels in accurately identifying operations in diverse and dynamic work settings. This research highlights the potential of smartwatches and deep learning in continuously analyzing sanitation workers’ duties and developing improved working regulations that consider their well-being and daily tasks.

articleTitle: Numerical Experiments with Artificial Life for Segmentation of Breast Ultrasound. Tests Against State-of-the-art
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In 2023 we offered a new model for segmentation of ultrasound (US) images of the breast which combines a grey level mask, Artificial Life (AL) and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) [1]. The model has been compared with 14 segmentation models which represented different ways to approach the problem i.e. deformable shapes, machine learning, superpixels, edge linking, Deep learning (DL) networks and various hybrids of DL with the conventional methods. The method outperformed 14 selected state-of-the-art algorithms applied to the US images characterised by complex geometry and a high level of noise. The present paper offers an extension of this algorithm where the step of the thresholding for generation of the image mask (fast but often not accurate) is replaced by a DL method. The proposed structure is a critical modification of the previous idea. It offers a new combination of the DL and AL. The novelty is an efficient compromise between the simplicity of the black-box DL network and the interpretability of the deterministic AL. The trained DL generates a mask which approximates the tumour. Since it is a rough approximation of the object, the DL network performs this task faster than an actual segmentation. Further, the AL exists inside the mask superimposed on the edge map. The AL trained by the GA outlines the tumors. The method shows promising results as applied to segmentation of complex US tumours handling even previously unseen data. The tests based on the characteristics of the US edge maps and the tumour shapes highlight the advantages of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Study to Automate Workload Assessment Procedure using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the field of occupational health, accurate and efficient ergonomic risk assessment is of paramount importance. This study presents an innovative computer vision-based approach to automate workload assessment with the goal of preventing work-related musculoskeletal disorders (WMSDs). Our methodology, which uses a two-step algorithm, captures 3D skeletal representations from video footage of workers performing tasks such as lifting, lowering, and carrying. We conducted experiments stratified by object weight and task height to simulate different workplace scenarios. Our system uses AlphaPose for human pose estimation and MotionBERT for 3D skeleton extraction to provide a dynamic and accurate assessment of workload. By analyzing spatial and contextual data, this method provides real-time ergonomic risk assessment, which is critical in today’s variable work environments.

articleTitle: Revealing Traders’ Stress Levels Through Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: It is known that investing mistakes are caused by fear and greed of traders. Based on the general adaptation syndrome theory (a human-stress cycle theory), fear and greed could assumably be represented by a state of fight or flight occurring in the alarm state of a stress cycle. Such stress state can be psycho-physiologically quantified through analyzing physiological signals such as photoplethysmography (PPG) or galvanic skin response (GSR). In this study, we developed a prototype device for measuring PPG and GSR based on the ESP32 microcontroller. The trier social stress test was selected as a protocol to collect such bio-signals. The experiments were conducted by performing a simulated trading platform based on the movement of the Bitcoin price. From the analysis results, it was found that when investors perceived fluctuations in price, an increase in stress levels was pronounced. This was statistically revealed by physiological parameters calculated from the recorded PPG during the relax (a period of low stress) and performance (a period of high stress) periods. Heart rate was found to be promising a biomarker which shows statistically significant difference (p-value < 0.05) between both periods. Heart rate could be used to track and monitor stress levels of traders while trading.

articleTitle: Optimal Tuning of PIDA Controller for Vehicle Cruise Control System by Modified Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The optimal tuning of the PIDA (proportional-integral-derivative-accelerated) controller for the vehicle cruise control system (VCCS) by using the modified bat algorithm (MBA), one of the most powerful metaheuristic optimization techniques, is proposed in this paper. Results obtained by the PIDA controller designed by the MBA will be compared with those obtained by the PID controller designed by the particle swarm optimization (PSO) and the MBA appeared in the literature. From simulation results, it was found that the PIDA controller is successfully optimized by the MBA. The VCCS controlled by the PIDA controller designed by the MBA gives very satisfactory step and ramp responses with faster responses and smaller oscillation than the $P I D$ controller designed by the MBA and PSO, respectively.

articleTitle: Interactive Packaging Design and Use of Augmented Reality Technology on Packaging for The Elderly A Case Study of Herbal Tea Products, Doi Mae Salong Subdistrict, Mae Fah Luang District, Chiang Rai
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The objectives of this research were to: 1) study the general condition of herbal tea packaging and problems with using packaging among the elderly;2) To design herbal tea packaging with the concept of universal design and use augmented reality (AR) technology to present product information. 3) To evaluate the effectiveness of herbal tea packaging and augmented reality technology (AR). The researcher has collected data from research documents. related theoretical concepts Together with the community participation process on information about the uniqueness of the Doi Mae Salong area, create story telling on the packaging. Then design herbal tea packaging for the elderly consumer group with the concept of universal design in 3 formats, using innovation combining augmented reality technology (augmenter reality) with the idea of allowing consumers to access the aesthetics of drinking herbal tea with all 5 senses: “form, taste, smell, sound, and touch” to show the value of the product, along with presenting the product through packaging that tells the story of the production source. and evaluate the effectiveness of herbal tea packaging and augmented reality (AR) technology. The tools used were: 1) semi-structured interviews to interview manufacturers, 2) a questionnaire on experts’ opinions on herbal tea packaging, and 3) a form to evaluate the effectiveness of herbal tea packaging and the use of augmented reality (AR) technology on the packaging. The population and sample consisted of 100 male and female tourists aged 60–69 years by purposive random sampling. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, mean, and standard deviation (SD). Results of evaluating the effectiveness of herbal tea packaging and augmented reality (AR) technology in designing packaging suitable for the elderly Convenience Sales promotion Augmented reality (AR) technology has the highest overall level, x = (4.52) s.d. (0.56).

articleTitle: Article Feed Recommendations Using Position-Aware Deep Cross Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The presence of social media platforms has recently transformed the digital landscape, with an ever-increasing user base. As these platforms become central to daily life, the need for recommendation systems that genuinely cater to individual preferences has never been more paramount. While current recommendation algorithms excel at curating content based on user interests, they often overlook inherent biases, notably the positional bias where users engage with content due to its placement rather than its inherent relevance. This oversight is particularly evident in every social media recommendation system. Addressing this challenge, we proposed a position-aware methodology within the Deep and Cross framework, aptly termed ‘Position-Aware DCN.’ By explicitly accounting for positional preferences, our proposed model aims to provide more genuine, unbiased recommendations, ensuring that users are presented with content that aligns with their interests and is not just influenced by its position in the feed. Evaluations conducted on Thai social media datasets reveal that our proposed model offers a marked improvement over traditional recommendation systems, underscoring its potential to foster a more user-centric digital experience.

articleTitle: New Switching Commutation for an Electronic Tap Changer
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper proposes the new commutation scheme to reduce the circulation current during commutation period for electronic On-load Tap Changer (OLTC). Because the bi-directional switches are used in the electronic OLTC, 4 step commutation should be applied. The proposed commutation method is also 4 steps sequence for commutation, and based on the information of the current direction and the polarity of voltage difference. Simulation results are verified the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comparison Model for Forecasting the Total Population in Bangkok
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The primary aim of this article is to investigate, contrast, and formulate a time series model to predict Bangkok’s overall population. In this study, we intend to propose a hybrid model that combines the Autoregressive Moving Integrated Average (ARIMA) model and machine learning techniques, utilizing a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). Our data source comprises monthly data from 2002 to 2022, totaling 252 data points, obtained from the official registration statistics system of the Registration Administration Office, Department of Provincial Administration. This dataset has been divided into two subsets: the first subset covers the years from 2002 to 2021, encompassing 240 data points, which will be used for constructing predictive models. The second subset consists of the data for the year 2022, comprising 12 data points, which will serve as a means to compare the accuracy of various forecasting methods. The evaluation criteria employed for this purpose are the minimum mean absolute error (MAE), the mean square error (MSE) and the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). Furthermore, we will utilize the Python programming language to facilitate data analysis.

articleTitle: Regularized Pyramid Convolutional Layers for Human Skin Type Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Skin type classification is significant in both dermatology and computer vision, serving in personalized skincare recommendations, disease diagnosis, and maintaining algorithmic fairness. The complex non-linear relationships among various skin characteristics, such as texture, color, elasticity, and sensitivity, poses challenges for traditional techniques and machine learning models in capturing the features effectively. In response to this challenge, this research introduces an innovative approach to enhance human skin type analysis through the application of Pyramid Convolutional Layers (PCL). Differing from conventional methods, this study addresses the limitations of existing models in accurately capturing the intricate relationships between different skin attributes. The Fitzpatrick17k dataset, comprising 16,577 clinical images from DermaAmin and Atlas Dermatologico, annotated using Fitzpatrick Scale labels through Scale AI and Centaur Labs, forms the foundational basis of the investigation. According to implications in dermatology, Pyramid Convolutional Layers were specifically chosen to regularize and capture multi-scale and contextual attributes, thereby enhancing classification accuracy. In the preprocessing stage, images undergo standardization through uniform resizing and center-cropping, aligning with a classification-centric approach. It found that the efficacy of the proposed method revealing significant accuracy improvements in skin type classification compared to traditional method. Comprehensive comparative analyses establish the superior performance of our architecture, emphasizing its potential to advance human skin type classification accuracy. This study contributes to the field of dermatological image analysis and highlights the broader applications of Pyramid Convolutional Layers, showcasing methodological advances at the intersection of computer vision and dermatology.

articleTitle: Task Management: A Case Study on Introducing the Problem Note Management System and Xerox Benchmarking Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The existing system of project and task management has notable flaws, making it difficult for implementers and developers to prioritize solutions and address problems in a timely manner. Unnecessary and redundant data entry further complicates decision-making processes. This research established a web application platform named the “Problem Note Management System” to improve project and task management of identified issues during system development. This case study utilized the Xerox benchmarking model to enhance efficiency and develop a user-friendly interface for project and task management by minimizing redundant data entry. The results of the new system are discussed, highlighting process-related aspects that provide clear issue status designations for developers and implementers during the benchmarking process.

articleTitle: Women in Supply Chain & Logistics Management: Undergraduates’ Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: To ensure supply chains can withstand unforeseen challenges, modern businesses are seeking ways to make them more resilient and adaptable. One underrepresented group that can help to address these issues in supply chains is women. To promote supply chain and logistics careers among women, it is important to identify the perspectives of society on different supply chain and logistics fields. This study attempts to identify the Sri Lankan undergraduate perceptions about six supply chain and logistics occupational aspects. Relative Importance Index (RII) technique was adopted to perform the analysis. According to the analysis results, Warehouse Management was found to be the most critical field followed by Distribution Management and Production Management fields with reference to the six occupational aspects considered in this study. Supply chain analyst/ business analyst was found as the most favorable field with reference to the six occupational aspects considered in this study. Furthermore, fields such as research and development, customer services information systems management, and consultancy services were found to have more favorable behaviors. The results of this study will assist practitioners in the industry in determining the most important areas that need to change to improve gender diversity in the industry.

articleTitle: Digital Threads of Heritage: Integrating Lanna Ethnic Identity into Character Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study explores digital character design as a medium for cultural education and edutainment, focusing on the Lanna ethnic identity. Integrating the traditional Lanna costume design into digital characters, research aims to create an effective tool for cultural learning. Emphasizing early cultural appreciation among young learners, the study combines Chibi character creation and paper doll artistry to form an interactive educational platform. This platform not only entertains but also imparts in-depth knowledge about Lanna culture and heritage. Collaborative efforts with design experts led to prototypes representing five Lanna ethnic groups: Tai Yuan, Tai Lue, Tai Yai, Tai Khuen, and Tai Yong, which were tested and evaluated for child engagement. The study examines the impact and potential outcomes of this unique approach, highlighting digital paper dolls as a dynamic tool for enhancing cultural awareness. It offers an immersive exploration of cultural diversity, emphasizing traditional costumes, and contributes significantly to fostering a broader cultural understanding for children.

articleTitle: Inspection Methodology for Improving Wafer Quality in Semiconductor Production
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The edge grinding process refers to the process of polishing the edge of the wafer during the wafer manufacturing process. Visual inspection and rule-based vision inspection are used to detect defective conditions after the process. In the case of visual inspection, the detection rate of defects are different depending on the skill level of the operator, so the defect classification results may be inconsistent. When the rule-based method is used, defects may not be detected or may be over-detected. To solve this problem, this paper is proposed a method to develop an automated system for the grinding process through vision inspection using deep learning. The proposed method is expected to strengthen responses to low productivity and quality problems and improve the competitiveness of the semiconductor industry. Recently, the demand for automation equipment is increasing due to the growth of semiconductor wafer factories, and the methodology proposed in this paper is expected to make a positive contribution to this trend.

articleTitle: Logistic cost factors of Rayong durian export to China under Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: China is currently the largest export market for Thai durians, and several studies have shown that China will maintain this position for a long time to come. At the same time, under the implementation of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) agreement. The purpose of this study is to analyze the impact of durian export logistics cost in Rayong city of Thailand through Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). Six experts were selected for in-depth interview and AHP factors evaluation. The top three affect factors were transportation cost (45.48%), transportation speed (22.73%), and labor cost (8.64%), respectively.

articleTitle: A Self-Adaptive Access Control Framework Based on User Attributes Among Heterogeneous Internet of Things Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) platforms are being actively designed to provide various services to users. However, most IoT platforms are developed in independent environments, causing difficulties in their interoperability. Even though heterogeneous IoT platforms employ the same attribute-based access control (ABAC) model to protect their resources, the attribute representation methods used by these platforms differ. Consequently, a semantic interoperability problem arises, wherein users of one platform cannot access the resources from other platforms, even though these users possess valid attributes. Therefore, this paper proposes a framework that can interoperate by understanding different attribute representation methods among heterogeneous IoT platforms that employ the same ABAC model. Our framework uses self-adaptive modules monitor-analyze-plan-execute over a shared knowledge (MAPE-K) to solve semantic interoperability problems arising from differences in attribute representations, even with valid attributes, enabling access to resources between heterogeneous IoT platforms.

articleTitle: Patiyoot 2: Key Distribution, and Session Key for Authentication Protocol in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Authentication is the process of recognizing a user's identity. It is the mechanism of associating an incoming request with a set of identifying credentials. The credentials provided are compared to those on a file in a database of the authorized user's information on a local operating system or within an authentication server. The authentication process always runs at the start of the application, before any other code is allowed to proceed. An authentication protocol is a type of cryptographic protocol specifically designed for transfer of authentication data between two entities. It allows the receiving entity to authenticate the connecting entity (e.g. Client connecting to a Server) as well as authenticate itself to the connecting entity (Server to a client). In this research paper, the updated of authentication protocol called “Patiyoot 2” is improved and explained, from “Patiyoot 1” authentication protocol [1]. It consists of ten steps. Each step is elaborated with the reason why it is done in such a manner. It enhances security from the previous one, which already had some security issues, such as using Nonce, ensure originality, and using Timestamp, ensure timeliness. In this updated version, it is addedthe session key in order for two nodes need not to authenticate one point in time, during the communication of two entities.

articleTitle: Local Mascot Design by Using Universal Design for Sustainable Community Development: A Case Study of PAA YAO CRAFT MARKET
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research aimed to design a mascot for the PAA YAO CRAFT MARKET by employing both sustainable development and a Universal design approach. The research tools included a focus group of 25 participants from governmental and private sectors. This research is used to explain the story and the local mascot design in Phayao Province. The findings indicated that there were 4 types as follows. Shape and form: the shape and form of the child wearing a peacock costume whilst doing activities meant the cultural lifestyles of the Phayao people. Material and texture: a means to publicize the material and texture met with economic and social conditions were created. Color and mood: it was found that reflected the culture, fertility, and creating a sustainable environment were pink and green. Size and proportion: it found that brought about interest as they were designed regarding environmentally friendly principles and the design was as naturally genuine as possible. Accordingly, this study has created a mascot that is like a symbol consisting of relationships and reflections of the society, culture, economy, and environment of Phayao province. The mascot also tells a beneficial and valuable story to the spectators at PAA YAO CRAFT.

articleTitle: Smart Facilities Management using Digital Twin with 3D Web-Based Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper introduces the integration of real-time 3D web-based digital twin with the facilities management to demonstrate the results of 1) environmental monitoring systems and 2) occupancy rates in educational institutions to address the inefficient use of spare rooms. The digital twin also provides a real-time environment display suitable for students and staff using temperature, noise, relative humidity, air quality, and occupancy sensors. The structure of this digital twin display system is designed based on open-source principles suitable for educational institutions, as it is cost-effective and accessible to everyone. The operational framework of this display system is designed based on open-source principles, utilizing three-dimensional visualization and swift data retrieval. This makes it suitable for application in educational institutions and government facilities due to its cost-effectiveness and accessibility for everyone. The system can display content on various devices (cross-browser), including PCs and smart devices, without pre-installed programs. Based on performance comparison results, the system can achieve an average frame rate of 73.89 frames per second, displaying large-scale building maps with triangular polygons totaling 90,000. This method can be further extended for the future development of large-scale building maps for smart cities in areas with limited budgets.

articleTitle: An Immersive Sound Effects System Based on Dynamic Spatial Perception and Architectural Response
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper achieves the conversion of monaural audio into spatially immersive stereo audio through the use of binaural speech synthesis and Pyroomacoustics. It integrates dynamic spatial perception with the acoustic response of architectural spaces to recreate immersive audio experiences in desired environments like concert halls. The system encompasses diverse options for motion trajectory generation and architectural space modeling within its interface, allowing users to customize and merge various environmental spatial effects and surround modes, delivering an unparalleled auditory encounter.

articleTitle: Investigation of HCI Effect and BTBT Supported High Ion/Ioff in Split Double-Gate Junctionless FETs
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this work, a n-type Split-Double-Gate Junctionless Field Effect Transistor (SDG-JLFET) has been investigated with the Sentaurus technology computer-aided design (TCAD) tool. The SDG-JFET device has an n-type channel region with constant doping concentration. The channel electrostatics have been controlled using two different gate regions. One of the gates toward the source end is the control gate, whereas the other one is the floating gate with different work function separated by a thin spacer region. This split gate structure suppresses the current during OFF state operation whereas it provides the band-to-band tunneling (BTBT) in the channel region in ON state, thereby improving the drain current. This study shows that the SDG-JLFET offers a better on-off current ratio (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf>) of $0.38 \times 10^{8}$ as compared to DGJLFET I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf> of $2.0 \times 10^{6}$. The SDG-JFET performance in terms of the hot carrier effect and the gate leakage current have also been analyzed, and the gate tunneling current was found to be $2.77 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~A} / \mu \mathrm{m}$ at constant drain voltage $\left(\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{DS}}\right)=1 \mathrm{~V}$.

articleTitle: A Study on the Cultural Factors That Influence Chinese Consumers to Purchase Thai Products Through Cross-Border E-Commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the cultural factors influencing Chinese consumers’ purchases of Thai products through cross-border e-commerce platforms. Utilizing Thai latex pillows as a case study, this research gathered online review data from the Tmall Global platform via Python software. Employing grounded theory methodology and data coding with Nvivo11.0, along with integrating Hofstede’s cultural dimensions theory, this study examined the cultural factors impacting the purchasing behavior of Chinese consumers. The research centered on five of Hofstede’s cultural dimensions: power distance, collectivism, uncertainty avoidance, femininity, and long-term orientation, to elucidate the purchasing behavior of Chinese consumers. It was discovered that these cultural dimensions are pivotal in comprehending the purchasing behavior of Chinese consumers in the cross-border e-commerce context. They offer a robust theoretical framework to scrutinize and elucidate how cultural factors shape the consumer decision-making process. This study underscores the practical application of Hofstede’s cultural dimensions theory in deciphering consumer behavior in specific markets, providing meaningful insights for research on cross-cultural marketing strategies.

articleTitle: Assessing the Digital Transformation Maturity of SMEs: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are the cornerstone of global economic growth that is sustainable. Technological advancement, market pressure, and the Covid pandemic accelerated SMEs’ digital transformation. However, the lower adaptability rate of digital technologies is a widespread issue around the world. Before implementing a digital strategy, it is critical to conduct a digital maturity assessment to determine the current state of the business. There is a lack of review articles regarding the digital maturity assessment of SMEs. Through a systematic literature search and an author keyword cluster analysis, this paper attempted to fill this gap. The paper demonstrates that this research domain could be divided into three major research clusters.

articleTitle: The Effect of Innovative Corporate Social Responsibility in Supply Chain Management on Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In order to enhance business firm performance (FP) and foster sustainability, Innovative Corporate Social Responsibility (ICSR), characterized by CSR driven by innovation, is currently under development and implementation in Supply Chain Management (SCM). The aim of this study is to investigate the trend of ICSR in SCM and its effects on FP across economic, social, environmental, and competitive dimensions. A systematic review revealed a consistent upward trend in the incidence of ICSR. Green Innovation (GI), Logistics Innovation (LI), and Sustainable Business Model Innovation (SBMI) emerge as the three most frequently employed ICSRs in SCM. GI is utilized for procuring goods and services, including the development of new eco-friendly products that attract clients and enable the firm to expand its market share. Furthermore, the incorporation of energy-efficient production technology is employed to reduce production costs. LI is employed for creating transportable objects and packaging, as well as for managing reverse logistics and reducing inventory costs through zero inventory management. Additionally, employing SBMI for crafting a business plan can contribute to enhancing the quality of life for clients. It also serves as an initiative to eliminate carbon emissions, demonstrating a commitment to addressing environmental and social concerns. This article recommends the application of ICSR to SCM for businesses aiming to improve FP over the long term.

articleTitle: Homecare Staff Scheduling with Three-step Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper introduces a three-step algorithm, an efficient framework for solving a homecare staff scheduling problem (HSSP) service schedule, a multi-objective problem requiring a combination of the VRP and the staff scheduling problem. The proposed scheduling technique takes account of the design of optimal daily service routes and the dispatch of caregivers to visit patients under time and capacity constraints. The framework consists of three major stages: Step 1) Route scheduling creates effective routes for homecare caregivers to service patients at different task locations with the shortest path. Step 2) Resource selection seeks to match qualified staff to each route with the minimum cost and preferences under possible time, qualification requirement constraints, and modes of transportation. Step 3) Local improvement enhances the output solution generated by the resource selection by swapping tasks based on the cost function. Our empirical study reveals that the proposed scheduling technique can explore the improved service plan for an adapted case study with the minimum service cost and highest efficiency for arranging service tasks compared to the manual procedure.

articleTitle: A Study on the Digitalization Methods, Visualization Technologies and Interactive Information Systems for Popularization of Tangible and Intangible Heritage
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Over the past thirty years, the rapid technological progress has sparked numerous breakthroughs in the area of the Information and Communication Technologies. This has resulted in the creation of numerous engaging, innovative and interactive methods for visualization, promotion and presentation of the historically significant landmarks and the objects with cultural value. The use of the new technologies and solutions has provided many new opportunities and possibilities for the cultural and historical institutions, but it has also presented a new set of challenges, including the costs of the digitalization and visualisation equipment and the related software products, the need for training of the unexperienced personnel and the abundance of regulatory constraints. All of these disadvantages have contributed to the slower acceptance and the delayed introduction of the technological innovations in the museums, galleries, libraries and other cultural institutions. This paper provides an analysis on some of the most popular approaches and methods for digitalization of tangible and intangible cultural and historical heritage. It also explores the ways to utilize of the digital content for the visualization, presentation and promotion of the heritage objects and sites.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Modelling Information and Body of Knowledge based on the Principle of Social Return on Investment Using Knowledge Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the past recent years, social value or social impact has been an increasing trend among social enterprises and public sectors. Making many organizations are required to evaluate and report the social and economic value they generated. Social Return on Investment (SROI) is the most popular and internationally accepted method for assessing social value. Despite there are many advantages of this method, there are some issues for applying SROI. The SROI required the trained personnel to use and have subjective issues in some part. This research objectives are i) to analyze and synthesize information and body of knowledge based on the Social Return on Investment in College of Arts, Media and Technology for designing decision support system and ii) to design decision support system for Social Return on Investment evaluation in College of Arts, Media and Technology. The goal is to offer solution for SROI which is DSS by using CAMT to be case study. Knowledge management process and knowledge engineering are used in methodology part for capturing knowledge from expert. After the knowledge is extracted and validated by expert and users, the user interface of DSS was designed from the acquired knowledge, to guide the knowledge workers to perform SROI evaluation following the expert procedure, reducing the struggle. Moreover, the user interface was designed to be user-friendly and reduce subjective issues.

articleTitle: Application of Knowledge Management in Oil and Gas Projects: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
