abstract: Knowledge management (KM) plays a pivotal role in enhancing the collaborative performance of the typical oil project owners and stakeholders with the complex landscape of oil and gas projects. The purpose of this systematic literature review is to provide an overview of the existing literatures on the application of KM practices by systematically synthesising and analysing related literature to identify key themes, challenges and best practices of project owners and stakeholders in the utilisation of KM. The latest application of KM in project management in the oil and gas industry is summarised in this paper providing insights that enable researchers and industrial practitioners to utilise KM in their future research and project.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Digital Advertising Effectiveness Based on Visual Style
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research aims to analyze and find out how effective digital advertising is based on the visual style of the advertisement from the consumer’s perspective. The advertisement studied came from the same brand but released two versions with two different visual styles, namely 2D animation and 3D animation. This research approach is descriptive and quantitative with the AISAS Model analysis method. There were 158 respondents taken using saturated sampling techniques, where members of the population were used as samples. Data were analyzed by distributing Likert scale questionnaires using the Paired t-test with the help of SPSS. The results of the research include: (1) the overall value of the AISAS (Attention Interest Search Action Share) dimension on the effectiveness of the 3D animated version of the Khong Guan advertisement using the Aisas model is 70.8% and is in a Good category; (2) The overall value of the AISAS (Attention Interest Search Action Share) dimension on the effectiveness of the 2D animated version of the Khong Guan advertisement using the Aisas model is 69.1% and is in a Good category; and (3) There is no effect or difference between the 2D and 3D groups.

articleTitle: Improving Performance and Explainability of Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Significant progress has been made in developing systems that can automatically recognize human activities, largely thanks to deep learning models and sensor data. However, high performance and comprehensibility are often at odds in these systems. The aim of this research is to enhance both the accuracy and understandability of models that use sensors for human activity recognition (HAR). We present a new convolutional neural network design which takes input from accelerometers and gyroscopes across multiple data streams. This allows efficient capture of time and frequency characteristics. Additionally, we put forward an attention module that identifies informative patterns in the sensor signals to shed light on the model’s predictions. Experiments were conducted on a benchmark dataset of common daily movements gathered from ubiquitous sensors. Our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy exceeding prior deep learning techniques. The attention visuals provide transparency into which sensor segments are most relevant for accurate activity classification. This validates improved model interpretability. Our multi-channel architecture pushes sensor-based HAR forward through heightened predictive performance. We offer original perspectives to create reliable, precise systems for HAR.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 and Beyond—Present Trends, Emerging Solutions and Future Technologies in the Area of the Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The constant development of new technologies and production methods and their integration in the various fabrication and manufacturing processes has fuelled several waves of novelties and innovations in the industrial domain, which are also known as the industrial revolutions. These transformative processes have changed humanity forever and have shifted the economic models and the manufacturing methods of our societies - from the hand-based farming and manual production of goods to the total utilization of information systems, machines and robots for the large-scale fabrication of high-quality products and the delivery of modern services. The industrial revolutions have led to increased production volumes, higher manufacturing efficiency, lower prices, better working conditions, improved salaries and to significant improvements of the infrastructure, the railroad and the road networks. The recent technological advancements and the development of novel paradigms for the use of autonomous robots, cyber-physical systems, artificial intelligence algorithms, quantum computing and nanotechnologies are slowly changing the overall landscape and are pushing humanity towards the next wave of Industrial revolutions. While these innovations are offer significant benefits, they are also presenting a new set of challenges for the companies and their staff. In this paper we present and discuss the present trends, emerging solutions and future technologies in the area of the Industrial Automation. The Introduction section of the paper provides a brief overview of the past and present Industrial revolutions and highlights the advantages and the disadvantages of their underlying technologies. The next chapter of the paper presents in more details the trending technologies and the solutions of the present-day Industrial Automation domain. The paper continues with discussions about the emerging Industry 5.0 technologies and solutions. The next chapter of the manuscript is dedicated to the potential future Industrial Automation technologies, which will most likely constitute the Industry 6.0 paradigm. Last, but not least, we conclude the paper with some discussions about the automation technologies and the main challenges, opportunities and needs of the Industrial sector.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Local Marketplace Application for Food and Beverage Businesses Using 4P’s and 4C’s Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Due to COVID-19 outbreak in Phuket, Thailand, there has been a huge impact on the economics because the Phuket economics relies on tourism. Many are unemployed or halved their salaries. Facebook marketplace is an easy and fast option to start a food and beverage business online, even though there are some drawbacks and limitations. This work studies food and beverage businesses and consumer behaviors using 4P’s and 4C’s marketing strategy to develop a solution for businesses in Phuket, Thailand. A Prototyping model in software engineering is employed to fabricate an application, namely UMARKET. The results reveal most common problems from the buyers and sellers which are available products in stock, order tracking, slow communication, manual input during the purchase, and delivery routing. UMARKET functionalities are developed to solve those problems and the user satisfactory is evaluated using usability testing method. The average score is 4.35 out of 5 with standard deviation of 0.71. We would conclude that most of the users satisfy UMARKET and it solves the problems encountered by Facebook marketplace users.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model of Knowledge Creation Using Agility and SECI Models to Motivate Active Learning of Academic Librarians
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The levels of job motivation, collaboration and innovation among academic librarians are on the decline, which results in poor job performance. This experimental research introduced a hybrid model of knowledge creation using Agility and SECI models (abbreviated as “SECI+AGILE”), which built upon the SECI model and the AGILE management approach, to enhance the job motivation, innovation, and collaboration of academic librarians. The sample for the study comprised 18 student volunteers enrolled for the library tour project in Dali University Library, in the southwest of China. In the first stage, this research used SECI model to create knowledge about the library tour project. In the second stage, this research implemented this knowledge based on the AGILE work process design. A validated self-constructed analytic rubric was employed to examine the effect of the implementation of the SECI model and AGILE management framework on student volunteers job motivation, innovation, and collaboration level. The results showed that the implementation of this hybrid model significantly improve the participants’ job motivation, collaboration and innovation rubric scores. Thus, it can be concluded that the hybrid SECI and Agility model is effective in improving the knowledge creation process, motivate participants’ active learning, and enhance team members’ job motivation, collaboration and innovation level.

articleTitle: Price action analysis in gold trading using deep learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: We introduce a new structural deep learning model with the purpose of learning price action trading features that subjective traders use to make trading decisions based on recent and actual price movements, rather than relying solely on technical indicators. The model combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to improve trend forecasting for gold prices and generate better trading signals compared to traditional strategies. Since gold prices are represented as time series data, it is appropriate to apply CNN and LSTM for forecasting. Our model concept revolves around CNN’s ability to detect price action features or patterns at different locations within the time series data, while LSTM maintains both short-term and long-term memory as a sequence over time. By leveraging their collaborative capabilities, the neural network model comprehends complex relationships between recent and actual price movements and trends in gold prices. Our study demonstrates that the combination of CNN and LSTM with price action trading features significantly enhances long-term trading performance.

articleTitle: A Study of Chinese Customer’s Demand on Thai Skin Care Product under the Framework of Customer Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Customer knowledge management refers to the source and application of customer knowledge, it is an activity to acquire customer knowledge and understand customer demand. It contains three steps: knowledge about customers, knowledge from customers, and knowledge for customers. This paper focuses on Chinese female customers’ demand for skin care products, takes Chinese women aged 20-40 as the research object, takes customer knowledge management theory as the research framework, and uses the Kano model as the research tool to investigate Chinese customers’ demand for skin care products. Through Kano’s results, it is concluded that Chinese female customers mainly have 7 must-be demands, 5 one-dimensional demands, 9 attractive demands, and 8 indifferent demands. According to the Kano results, this paper makes a comparison between Thai skincare products’ current functions and identifies the actual demands of Chinese customers. Finally, this paper summarizes the problems that need to be improved in Thai enterprises and proposes effective measures.

articleTitle: Nourishing the Spirit of Lanna:Stream Management and Cultural Heritage Revival through Cultural Capital, Knowledge, and Social Theory Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper presents a strategic framework for revitalizing the culturally significant of Chiang Mai’s waterways, integral to its cultural legacy. The “Lost Local Stream” initiative goes beyond academic study to recover and celebrate the historical narratives of five community sites: the ancient sacred spring of Wiang Jed Lin, the revival of Nong Bua’s memories, the reinstatement of the Yi Peng tradition through Sa-pao crafts, the Nantaram Community’s heritage, and the indigenous water management expertise at Phaya Kham Weir. The aim of this initiative is to revive community interaction with Chiang Mai’s historical waterways, fostering development that honors local heritage by intertwining Cultural Capital, Knowledge Management, and Social Capital Theories. This research draws on the combined strength of three theories to deepen the understanding and practical application of cultural capital, specifically geared towards Lanna’s heritage conservation goals. The expected results of this initiative encompass strengthening community identity, revitalizing historical narratives, and reinforcing the cultural significance of the region to impact the community a positively and innovative economy that thrives on creativity and cultural richness. This project underscores the necessity of a sustainable, balanced approach to cultural heritage management, pairing economic advancement with the preservation and homage to cultural mores, to cultivate a dynamic, culturally vibrant Chiang Mai that harmonizes its ancestral roots with contemporary urban progress.

articleTitle: Hybrid Attention with CNN-BiLSTM and CBAM for Efficient Wearable Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The use of widespread sensors for automatic activity recognition has become a dynamic area of research due to its broad applications in healthcare, fitness monitoring, and assisted living. To efficiently identify daily and sports activities from sensor data, this study suggests a hybrid deep learning model that integrates convolutional neural networks (CNN), bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) networks, and convolutional block attention modules (CBAM). The model starts by extracting spatial features from the sensor data using CNN layers. These spatial features are then employed to offer temporal context information to the BiLSTM network. To conclude, the CBAM attention mechanism is applied to guide the model’s focus to the most informative segments of the BiLSTM feature maps. This approach enables the accurate recognition of patterns in both complex and daily sports activities. The effectiveness of the proposed hybrid model is evaluated using the UCI-DSA, a publicly available benchmark dataset that includes sports and daily activities collected through wearable motion sensors. In contrast to existing approaches, the outcomes reveal that a unified framework involving CNN, BiLSTM, and CBAM achieves outstanding performance in activity recognition, exceeding $99 \%$ in both accuracy and F1-score while maintaining computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Unveiling Waste Patterns in Tea Smallholder Producer Supply Chains: A Case Study from a Developing Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The sustainable management of waste in supply chains is of utmost importance, particularly in the context of smallholder producers. This paper aims to unveil waste patterns in the supply chains of smallholder tea producers in Sri Lanka by employing an integrated approach that incorporates Value Chain Mapping (VCM), lean thinking, and Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM). The study investigates the complexities and interdependencies within the supply chains and identifies key waste generation points and factors contributing to waste in the context of the smallholder tea producer industry in Sri Lanka. The ISM methodology facilitates the development of a comprehensive framework that enables the devising and effective implementation of waste reduction strategies for the smallholder farming sector. The findings highlight root causes such as inadequate investment, regulatory gaps, technology limitations, and contract issues, which are identified as critical hindrances. Vulnerable waste drivers, including limited market access, reduced yield, compromised quality, and low replanting rates, underscore the significance of addressing these challenges through strengthened regulations, technology integration, and improved contracts. This, in turn, can enhance supply chain resilience and sustainability, promoting inclusive economic progress for smallholders and facilitating broader environmental sustainability in the smallholder farming sector.

articleTitle: Metaverse Integration in Academic Libraries: A Library Tour for First-Year Students in Academic Research and Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper explores the integration of a metaverse within Chiang Mai University Library, presenting a comprehensive evaluation that combines quantitative metrics and insights. The study involved the active participation of firstyear students through online platforms, utilizing Meta Quest 2 equipment. The Satisfaction Questionnaire, administered to students from various faculties, reveals a high level of user satisfaction across key dimensions, including User Interface, Content Relevance, Interactive Features, Accessibility, and Overall Satisfaction. The metaverse’s success in enriching the academic experience is evident, as indicated by positive mean scores and low standard deviations, reflecting a consensus among users. Future research directions include exploring enhanced interactivity, developing personalized content strategies, and conducting longitudinal impact studies. However, certain limitations, such as sample size constraints, technological considerations, and the learning curve associated with navigating virtual environments, are acknowledged. This study contributes to the growing discourse on metaverse applications in academic libraries, providing valuable insights for continuous refinement and optimization.

articleTitle: A Study of Factors Influencing Cross-border E-commerce Platform Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study selected Thai university students with experience using cross-border platforms as research subjects. It used SPSS AMOS software to analyze 323 valid questionnaires using a structural equation model. The research sought to investigate the effects of the quality of cross-border platforms in the Thai market on Thai customers’ purchase intention. The service of cross-border e-commerce platforms was divided into six dimensions: ease of use, appearance design, security, responsiveness, reliability, and caring. The results showed that each service quality dimension of cross-border e-commerce platforms positively affects purchase intentions. Of these, responsiveness has the most significant impact on purchase intention.

articleTitle: On Reducing the Number of Gaussians for Radiance Field Real-Time Rendering
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Various Radiance Field methods have been recently explored for photo-realistic novel-view synthesis of scenes captured with multiple views given a set of images. However, none of them has provided the high visual quality with the real-time rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) without a trade-off in neither the speed nor the quality. On the other hand, the astonishing improvements of 3D Gaussian Splatting come at the cost of having a huge storage footprint due to the massive number of gaussians per model. In this paper, we focus on further optimizing the creation of gaussians throughout the training iterations to control the number of gaussians needed to represent the model. We propose three modifications blocks to the original Gaussian Splatting method that allow the state-of-the-art visual quality with lower number of gaussians while maintaining the same training time and real-time rendering of the original Gaussian Splatting method. By means of diverse simulations, our modifications effectively minimize the number of gaussians with a slightly improved visual quality or a negligible loss in the visual quality according to which of the proposed blocks are applied.

articleTitle: Develop Board Games to Enhance Knowledge and Understanding of Learning Basic Programming for Children in Remote Areas: Empirical Study for Schools in Chiang Rai Province
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Programming has emerged as a crucial educational skill, as its acquisition correlates with the enhancement of students’ reading, writing, creative, computational, and problem-solving aptitudes. This significance is particularly pronounced in a global landscape transitioning into the 4.0 era, characterized by pervasive information technology integration into daily life. This research endeavors to explore the potential of utilizing board games for coding education, specifically targeting student demographics lacking access to modern technology and educational resources, such as ethnic groups or remote populations distanced from urban centers. The board game’s efficacy in augmenting programming comprehension was evaluated through testing and feedback solicited from students and teachers in schools across Chiang Rai Province. Moreover, insights from computer science educators were incorporated to refine gameplay and enrich knowledge components, ensuring adaptability and applicability for future educational contexts.

articleTitle: Thailand Water Meter Reading Using Convolutional Neural Networks From Smartphone Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Water services are supplied by governmental agencies or private firms in many nations, with water delivered to houses via a network of pipes known as waterworks. The households typically consume water over a period of a month, after which the authority in charge evaluates the total amount of water consumed by each household and provides matching invoices. Thus, every household must install a water meter to ensure precise water consumption measurement. In Thailand, the procedure of collecting and reporting readings from these water meters is currently done manually by staff, which can be time-consuming and error-prone. The research’s fundamental purpose is to develop a detection model capable of accurately identifying numbers on water meters within images captured using mobile devices. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) were employed as the primary methodology for constructing the desired predictive models. This research is specifically dedicated to the task of reading values from water meters used in Thailand, encompassing five distinct models of water meters. The accuracy of these models is categorized into two components: one for precisely locating a set of numbers on water meters with a precision rate of 99.7%, and the other for accurately reading these numbers with a precision rate of 96.60%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Employee Onboarding through Gamification: A Novel Approach in Web Application Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The process of employee onboarding plays a crucial role in achieving organizational success. An emerging trend in this field involves usage gamification, which aims to improve engagement and enhance learning outcomes among newly hired individuals. This study discovers the gamification's impact on employee onboarding using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) framework. The results show a positive influence on various onboarding aspects: enhancing perceived utility, ease of use, engagement, motivation, and learning outcomes. A questionnaire-based survey took place to participants who were interns currently in junior and senior classes of fourth-year students. The findings demonstrate the diverse levels of impact that gamification has on many facets of the onboarding procedure, and this interconnected dynamic among perceived utility, ease of use, and engagement/motivation highlights their mutual influence in gamified onboarding.

articleTitle: Current Status of Seismic Performance Research on Bamboo Construction and its Prospective Applications in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The purpose of this conference paper is to reveal the current state of seismic performance research on bamboo structural buildings based on a systematic literature review. The significant contribution by China to this domain is highlighted and the scarcity of knowledge management tools in the research of seismic performance for bamboo construction is emphasised. It is demonstrated that the most of the studies are of reconstituted bamboo, while there is relatively little research on raw bamboo. Although these studies unquestionably offer valuable references for establishing seismic standards for bamboo construction consistent with the Thai region, it is important to also consider the native resource conditions of Thailand. It is suggested in this paper that future research endeavours should involve the use of indigenous Thai bamboo materials for a deeper investigation, and that the SNA theory should be applied in order to pinpoint and assimilate expert knowledge within the realm of bamboo construction.

articleTitle: Cultural Representation in Digital Art: Mascot Designs Expressing the Diversity of Tai Ethnic Cultures
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research focuses on the creation of digital mascots to represent the diverse cultures of Tai ethnic groups in the Lanna Kingdom or Northern Thailand in a present day, namely Tai Yuan, Tai Lue, Tai Yai, Tai Khuen, and Tai Yong. Research emphasizes the importance of accurate and respectful cultural representation in digital mascot design, highlighting the ethical considerations and the potential impact on public perception and understanding of Tai ethnic cultures.The paper outlines a comprehensive approach to mascot design, including extensive cultural research, consultations with cultural experts, and the use of advanced digital art techniques to ensure authenticity and respectfulness in representation. It discusses the challenges and opportunities in depicting cultural nuances in digital art, and the influence of such representations on public perception and cultural understanding.The study concludes by asserting the significance of digital mascots as tools for fostering global cultural understanding and education. It proposes future research directions in the field of digital art and cultural representation, underscoring the importance of digital mascots in cultural education and preservation. This work serves as a valuable resource for understanding the intersection of digital media, art, and cultural heritage preservation.

articleTitle: Study on International Researcher Cooperation Networks to Build Research Collaboration Competence in ASEAN Country.
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The study on international researcher cooperation networks to build research collaboration competence in ASEAN countries was conducted as part of the high-performance manpower development plan under Strategies 3 and 4 of Program Management Unit for Human Resources & Institutional Development, Research and Innovation (PMU-B). The study began by understanding the business and gathering information on leading ASEAN researchers from five selected industries: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Quantum, Earth and Space, High Energy Physics, and Bio Circular Green Economy (BCG). The data was collected from the databases of SCOPUS and SciVal, total number 8,220 items. The data was then analyzed using descriptive and diagnostic methods to examine the trend and distribution of talented people in ASEAN. The results were categorized based on the production of research articles in the past 10 years, which can help the ASEAN community collaborate on research and determine research directions with the intention of creating an impact for the ASEAN group in the future. The study’s findings will be used to design and develop the ASEAN Talent Mobility platform, which will be a tool used to drive the creation of a collaborative network of international researchers in groups in ASEAN countries.

articleTitle: Bibliometric and Thematic Analysis of Competency Mismatch Between University and Labor Market Using VOS Viewer and Power BI
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the context of COVID-19 and Industry 4.0, the market’s requirements for college graduates have changed. However, the problem of competency mismatch between university and labor market exists all over the world. This has caused difficulty in the employment of graduates. The objective of this review paper is to identify the global trend of competency mismatch between university and labor market. To identify the global trend, a systematic literature review (SLR) is applied to do the biological analysis and thematic analysis via VOS viewer and Microsoft Power BI. Two research questions are solved in this review paper, they are 1) Is there a problem that competency mismatch between university and labor market in various majors around the world? (RQ1); and 2) what are the implementation solutions for the problem that competency mismatch between university and labor market in various majors around the world? (RQ2) The findings are 1) most of the articles demonstrate the existence of the problem that competency mismatch between university and labor market in various majors around the world, but rarely do articles use data from the labor market; 2) a few articles provide solutions to the problem, and very few put the solutions into implementation.

articleTitle: A digital transformation approach to scaffold tourism crowding management: pre-factum, on-factum, and post-factum
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Tourism would probably not be economically sustainable without some localized crowding phenomena. Whatever the carrying capacity of the points of interest, their tourism managers should plan, monitor, and analyze visitors’ crowding data to either prevent or mitigate the well-known effects of tourism overcrowding, such as degrading the tourists’ experience, impacting negatively the environment and the local population, be it humans or wildlife.The proposed digital transformation approach comprises three smart tourism tools (STTs) to scaffold crowding management issues, especially those related to overcrowding, i.e. when the carrying capacity of points of interest is exceeded. We report on the development and validation experiments of these STTs in the scope of the European Union RESETTING project.The pre-factum STT aims at supporting simulation-based participatory discussions among tourism destination stakeholders. Proactive planning based on simulated scenarios allows the identification of potential tourism overcrowding situations and experimenting with possible mitigation actions.The on-factum STT enables local monitoring of tourism crowding, by using several Wi-Fi activity sensors. The ability to obtain near real-time data, allows short-term decision-making, such as reinforcing or freeing up human and technical resources assigned to managing tourist crowding on the ground.The post-factum STT is a geo-temporal 3D visualization platform to explore historical crowding data, visualize patterns, and understand and forecast trends. The main objectives of this STT are fostering cumulative learning from experience and forecasting the recurrence of troublesome crowding situations, allowing us to plan for mitigation actions.

articleTitle: The Effect of Anchor Characteristics on The Consumer Purchase Intention:Focus on The Comparative Analysis of Chinese And Thai Consumer
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: With the emergence of the “live broadcast + e-commerce” model, more and more enterprises will incorporate the live broadcast model into their important strategic plans to develop overseas markets. Anchor, as an important part of live broadcasting, plays an important role in communication between customers and commodities and will have a significant impact on consumer purchasing intention. However, scholarly research on the characteristics of Anchor and mechanisms that affect consumer purchasing intention is still scant. To fill this research gap, this study is based on the S-0-R model, combined flow theory, and perceived trust theory to explore the mediating role of flow experience and perceived trust between anchor characteristics and consumer purchase intention. It was found that the flow experience and perceived trust play an important mediating role between anchors’ characteristics and consumers’ purchase intention, and there is a significant difference between the two mediating effects. Professionalism affects purchase intention through perceived trust, but entertainment affects purchase intention through flow experience.

articleTitle: Preserving Performance and Reducing Energy Consumption: A Two-Phase Scheduling Approach in Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Cloud computing has evolved significantly, transitioning from traditional on-demand architectures to decentralized, multi-provider models. This shift is pivotal for enhancing connectivity in the Internet of Things and data-intensive computing. While accessing shared online resources, effective task scheduling is crucial for optimal service performance. However, the challenge persists in balancing resource optimization with potential issues like energy wastage or service performance degradation. This study proposes a two-phase scheduling approach in distributed computing, addressing the balance between performance preservation and energy reduction. The method seamlessly integrates with existing algorithms, employing a prescheduling phase followed by a model to estimate processors, minimizing underutilization. Experimental results highlight its contribution to energy-efficient scheduling, emphasizing a nuanced balance between performance and energy consumption. The approach employs a mathematical model to determine suitable processors, providing versatile options for computational resource providers, aiming for energy-conscious and performance-oriented solutions.

articleTitle: A Novel Salary Prediction System Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to build a salary prediction system using machine learning techniques. The experiments are done using the data from 1994 census database which has 32,561 records of employee data. The techniques used in determining whether an employee salary is less than or greater than ${\$}$50,000 are: logistic regression, decision tree, Naive Bayes classifier, K-nearest neighbor, and support vector machine. We implement these algorithms using original train data and oversampled train data. The results of these models are analyzed and compared with respect to accuracy. According to the experimental results, decision tree model outperforms the other models with original train data.

articleTitle: Study on Footprint Coverage of Communication Satellite in Cambodia
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Communication Satellites provides facilitate communication quickly and reliably over long distances with a wide range through the use of radio waves. And it allows radio, television, telephone transmissions, and many others to be sent live anywhere in the world. To solve many problems like that, Communication Satellite networks are now an indispensable part of most major telecommunication systems. Satellites have a unique capability for providing coverage over large geographical areas in the way that they work with LEO orbit. For latency reduction, LEO become the most popular orbit for researchers to study. In this paper, we will focus only on satellite Internet service to provide high-speed Internet via satellite to the Earth. To estimate the received signal strength at each point to get footprint coverage, we might use some software to measure the received signal at each point to verify and modify the model by calculating and looking for the footprint coverage of communication satellites in Cambodia. To find all these problems in projects, we have been using some tools for testing and implementing the way that satellites and the Earth rotate. Like MATLAB software for analysis, and calculation of the link budget for the propagation model. As optional, we also use a professional space-analysis software satellite Tool kit AGI’s STK for visualization.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Live-streaming Shopping On Chinese Customers’ Experience in the Domestic Cosmetic Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Live streaming shopping (LSS) is a well-received approach that mixes live broadcasting and E-commerce to promote goods and establish rapid connections with customers. It is a place where buyers and sellers can frequently and meaningfully connect in real-time to make transactions. Chinese consumers spend significant money and time on LSS, with cosmetics being one of the main categories of goods purchased. However, Chinese consumers tend not to purchase make-up made in China but prefer other countries’ brands. This study aims to investigate how Chinese LSS cosmetic businesses might improve the caliber of their client experience quality by comprehending the variables that influence client satisfaction. This study utilized the EXQ (customer experience quality) scale to understand the effect on customer experience of LSS in the domestic cosmetics market. According to the subject focus, two additional dimensions: visual experience and information quality were employed to evaluate customer experience quality appropriately in improving the target customer’s experience. Significant associations with marketing outcomes such as satisfaction, loyalty intention, and word of mouth in domestic cosmetic markets were examined. A questionnaire was distributed to collect data for analysis. IOC (item objective congruence) and pilot SEM (structural equation modeling) were applied as the main analysis methods. Results from this study show evidence of the revised EXQ scale for main marketing outcomes and help to formulate more effective domestic brand and cosmetic brand marketing strategies tailored to the LSS platform.

articleTitle: Chinese Language Learning Framework for Thai Vocational Students using PKM and PLE
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Nowadays,with more and more Thai vocational school students learning Chinese as a foreign language, this research tries to comprehensively understand the corresponding challenges and issues. In order to address the specific needs of these students and enhance their Chinese language learning experience, this paper aims to design a Chinese language learning framework for Thai vocational school students to improve their Chinese language learning outcomes. The proposed framework provides Thai vocational students with a personalised and practical learning environment to facilitate their active engagement in the learning process. Students incorporate the critical concepts of personal knowledge management and personal learning environment to improve overall Chinese language proficiency.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting the Short-Form Video Consumption on Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper aims to examine the various factors that influence the consumption of short-form video on social media platforms. The examination includes both internal and external factors affecting user engagement. The study integrated the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Uses and Gratifications Theory (UGT). The research approach employed was a systematic literature review, wherein data were obtained from several databases spanning the years 2018 to 2023. There were 13 articles that matched the search criteria. There are five internal factors that explain the customers’ motivation and twenty-eight external factors that explain the utilization of technology. This paper propose that future investigations should encompass a broader range of business domains and use other theoretical frameworks to better understand short-form video consumption’s behavior.

articleTitle: Authenticity of Social Media Influencers: A Literature Review and Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The true, real, and legitimate things are considered authenticity, which is an important cue for audiences to develop their attitudes. People trust message sources with authenticity. Social media influencers are named influencers because they can persuade audiences. Authenticity is an important feature of social media influencers that links to their persuasion power. As a result, authenticity is an important dimension in evaluating social media influencers. The study identifies the recent research trend of the authenticity of social media influencers by searching the SSCI/SCI database. By analyzing the published 210f research articles, the study discusses the research trend and reveals the highly cited research article on the authenticity of social media influencers. The results provide essential insights into the booming research topics of authenticity of social media influencers.

articleTitle: A draft drawing structure tool for improve 3D modeling process in student
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this research, the concept of applying the student’s original learning based on the course or skills related to the use of hand drawing and sketching was applied by creating a 3D structure drawing and dividing it into 2 groups between Non-Draft Groups and Draft Groups Both groups created 3D models and assessed the structures. Upon examination, it was found that the structural drawing group produced 3D models with higher 3D structural evaluation scores than the other group. To show that the use of the sketch helps the 3D structure to be more complete.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Sales of Thai Latex Pillows on Taobao and Lazada Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The objective of this study is to compare the sales of Thai latex pillows on Taobao and Lazada platforms. This study collected Thai latex pillow sales data on Taobao and Lazada platforms. A mixed approach is employed in this study, using the 4Ps of marketing mix as a research theory. The study centered on four factors: product, price, place, and promotion, to analyze the sales of Thai latex pillows on Taobao and Lazada platforms. This study found that Taobao’s clientele favors products with perceived higher quality, underscored by a focus on imported materials and health benefits. Lazada’s consumer base predominantly opts for non-branded, cost-effective options. Taobao’s pricing spans a wide spectrum, indicating a strategy to attract diverse market segments, whereas Lazada’s competitive pricing is indicative of targeting price-conscious consumers. This study offers valuable implications for marketers and platform operators, highlighting the necessity for tailored strategies to meet the distinct preferences of each platform’s customer base.

articleTitle: Exploring Individual Creativity Components of Anime Videos via Content Analysis: A Case Study of Bilibili
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The development of video-sharing platforms has impacted and stimulated the anime creation online, as well as creativity in anime videos. Yet, compared to other platforms, Bilibili, an online video-sharing platform with great potential, is rarely mentioned. As one of the most popular anime communities among the young generation in China, Bilibili contains the biggest content of anime videos while enjoying a high level of audience engagement. Despite this, the specific underlying components of individual creativity in anime videos on Bilibili were not explained enough. Thus, it provides an opportunity to explore the individual creativity components and provide suggestions for improving the anime video creation on Bilibili. In order to understand individual creativity components in anime videos, content analysis becomes a suitable method in this study since it is flexible for text and non-text data. This study applied the componential theory of creativity to identify the components as domain-relevant skills, creativity-relevant processes, intrinsic task motivation, and affective state. A coding framework was developed as a crucial part of content analysis to analyze the transcription of anime videos on Bilibili. Accordingly, this study synthesized the frequency and ratios of creativity components and the general distribution of components across anime videos on Bilibili. Among the sample of 20 anime videos, the results indicate that creativity-relevant processes occurred most frequently, which best demonstrated creativity, followed by domain-relevant skills and affective state. In contrast, intrinsic task motivation occurred least frequently, which showed less attention in anime video creativity. Eventually, suggestions for the individual creativity components for creating anime videos on the Bilibili platform were revealed in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cultural Promotion Strategies in Video Gaming Through the Application of the Kano Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of the global gaming industry, the fusion of diverse cultural elements with video games emerges as a critical facet for capturing and retaining a broad spectrum of player audiences. This paper investigates the optimization of cultural elements in video gaming, focusing on user satisfaction through applying the Kano Model and Design Thinking. Grounded in the dynamic landscape of video game design, the study employs the Kano Model to categorize cultural elements into must-be, one-dimensional, and attractive requirements, offering a nuanced understanding of their impact on user experience. Guided by Design Thinking principles, the research iteratively refines strategies, resulting in a comprehensive framework for enhanced gaming experiences through cultural integration. The primary objective is to decipher player preferences concerning cultural elements, thereby offering practical and actionable insights for game developers aiming to enrich the cultural dimensions of their creations.

articleTitle: A Study of Factors Influencing Chinese Consumers’ Purchase of Thai Products via E-Commerce Platforms.
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study aims to explore the marketing strategies that influence Chinese consumers to purchase Thai products through e-commerce platforms. Take three typical platforms, Tmall, JD.com and Pinduoduo, as examples for analysis. The research background and purpose section introduces Chinese consumers’ interest in Thai products and explores the impact of e-commerce platforms on their purchasing decisions. The literature review outlines the key factors in consumer purchasing behaviour and the role of e-commerce platforms and marketing strategies in this. The research theory part uses 4P theory to analyse the strategies of Tmall, JD.com and Pinduoduo in promoting Thai products, pricing, channels and promotions. The data collection and analysis section explains the questionnaire design and sample selection, as well as the data collection and analysis methods. The research results revealed the key factors that influence consumers to purchase Thai products through e-commerce platforms, and through SWOT analysis, the main advantages and disadvantages of each platform’s marketing strategy were obtained. It provides e-commerce platforms with valuable information, helping them better understand target consumers, adjust marketing strategies, and provide products and services that better meet their needs.

articleTitle: Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease using Machine Learning Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is a progressive and and irreversible brain disorder that basically affects memory, thinking, and behavior. Overtime, people with this disease experience confusion, difficulty with language and changes in personality. Detecting Alzheimer’s is a complex and time-consuming task that requires brain imaging reports and human expertise. The main aim of the proposed work is to develop a smart and reliable way to diagnose disease at an early stage. Early diagnosis enables timely intervention and treatments which results in potentially slowing down progress of the disease. Identifying individuals with MCI (Mild Cognitive Impairment) who are about to get migrated into Alzheimer’s disease is important in both clinical trials and practices. Combining MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) data and neuro-psychological test results as inputs to a multi-dimensional space for the classification of disease is a promising approach. This approach can lead to several benefits and ultimately resulting in better decisions and significant savings. In the proposed work, Multiple datasets Alzheimer’s disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) and the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) are used. A variety of supervised machine learning algorithms have been applied for automatic Alzheimer’s disease detection. The performance metrics with respect to the accuracy values have been analyzed and from the results, it is observed that the minimum accuracy of 67.75% is achieved in AdaBoost and a maximum accuracy of 80.22% has been achieved using Gradient Boosting Classifier.

articleTitle: Ensemble Framework for Bankruptcy Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: When a company faces bankruptcy, it refers to a there is insufficient cash available to pay bills, or the total value of its assets is less than its overall liabilities, including potential future obligations. It is significant to recognize or predict business bankruptcy promptly when companies face financial difficulties. This research introduces an ensemble framework for bankruptcy prediction, which integrates different predictive models to enhance overall prediction performance. The proposed framework is represented as an ensemble learning method that combines a neural network model and a logistic regression model, leveraging the unique strengths of each technique to provide accurate bankruptcy predictions. The experiment involved a dataset comprising 78,682 samples. The prediction outcomes of the proposed ensemble learning method were compared with those of general neural network, deep neural network, and logistic regression models, utilizing various metrics such as accuracy, ROC curve, AUC, precision, recall, and F1-score. The comparative result highlighted that the proposed method achieved the highest accuracy (93.54%), demonstrating high performance in the domain of bankruptcy prediction compared to the other models.

articleTitle: Phrase Embedding for Matching Job Skills with Job Position with Low Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Word embedding, a technique in natural language processing, has revolutionized various text analysis tasks. By representing words as dense vectors in a high-dimensional space, word embedding models capture semantic relationships and facilitate downstream applications. However, the inherent limitations of word embedding become evident when attempting to derive the meaning of phrases. This study explores the efficacy of phrase embedding techniques in matching job skills with job descriptions within low-resource environments. We compare the performance of two popular word embedding models: Continuous Bag-of-Words (CBOW) and Skip-gram. Using a dataset of ICT professionals, we achieved an average accuracy of 69.73% with CBOW and 77.62% with Skip-gram, demonstrating their ability to capture semantic relationships between job position and skill. We also explore the rationale behind pre-processing steps, such as replacing spaces with underscores to maintain the meaning of skill phrases. This research contributes valuable insights into applying NLP techniques for job and skill matching in human resource analysis.

articleTitle: A Study of Factors Affecting the Free Trade of Thai Cocoa Products in China’s E-commerce Market of Hill Tribe Cocoa Cof Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study examines the factors influencing Chinese consumers’ willingness to purchase Thai cocoa products within the context of free trade in the Chinese e-commerce market, using Hill Tribe Cocoa Cof Limited as a case study. Through path analysis, it was found that various factors influence consumer purchasing intentions. Consumers’ habitual use and trust in e-commerce platforms significantly positively affect their purchase intentions. Moreover, precise branding and promotional strategies positively impact product sales. Additionally, high-quality logistics services, alignment with market demands, superior product quality, and products resonating with local culture significantly influence consumers’ willingness to purchase. These findings offer clear directions for companies, suggesting optimization of brand positioning, improved logistics services, enhanced product quality, and alignment with local cultures. This research provides valuable guidance for cocoa product trade in the Chinese e-commerce market under free trade conditions, offering robust support and recommendations for business decisions. This research bears substantial significance within the commercial landscape, offering a roadmap for companies aiming to thrive within the intricate dynamics of the Chinese e-commerce market amid the canvas of free trade. Its elucidation of consumer behavior and market influences provides concrete directions for optimizing strategies, enhancing product appeal, and navigating cultural nuances, thereby presenting a valuable resource for businesses seeking to capitalize on the burgeoning opportunities within this domain.

articleTitle: Increase Security by Analyzing Password Strength using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Passwords (and login credentials) are pivotal in our daily online activities, securing ‘things’ including emails and e-wallets. Yet, users tend to recycle similar passwords across multiple services, posing a significant security threat. The prevalence of easily guessed passwords exacerbates the security issues. This study proposes a machine learning model leveraging Term Frequency – Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) scores that helps develop stronger passwords by analyzing how frequently specific characters appear in passwords. The proposed methodology involves utilizing logistic regression and the 000WebHost leaked password wordlist for training and validation. The outcomes of the machine learning model accurately assess users’ password strength, potentially bolstering the security of their diverse online accounts.

articleTitle: Developing a Tourism Promotion Digital Platform to Enhance of Technology Acceptance in the Sharing Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The objectives of this research are: (1) to develop a digital platform prototype that promotes tourism in sharing economy, and (2) to compare the acceptance of digital technology in promoting tourism in sharing economy through workshop. The research is conducted in two phases. Phase 1 involves the development of a digital platform for promoting in sharing economy tourism using design thinking innovation. A mobile application called “Friend trips” serves as a technological prototype to create alternative careers and additional income for the citizen. The developed digital platform demonstrates high efficiency (Mean = 4.48, S.D. = 0.51), and users express the highest level of satisfaction (Mean = 4.61, S.D. = 0.48). Phase 2 of the study involves a comparative analysis of the acceptance of digital technology in promoting tourism in the sharing economy, derived from workshop. The research will be conducted using a quasi-experimental research design. The sample group consists of individuals residing in Nong Bua sub-district, Mueang Chanthaburi district, Chanthaburi province. It was found that the sample group demonstrated a higher acceptance of digital technology in promoting tourism in the sharing economy, compared to before undergoing practical training. This statistical significance was observed at the 0.001 level.

articleTitle: Recommender System to Identify Drug-Target Associations Using Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Recommender systems, widely used in information filtering systems, demonstrate efficacy in suggesting novel items to users. In this study, we propose the application of a recommender system to predict new drug-target associations. Here, drugs are represented as users, while protein targets are treated as items within the recommender system. However, due to sparse data in a matrix of drugs and protein targets, matrix factorization (MF) techniques are employed to decompose the extensive matrix into smaller matrices. We identify non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) and singular value decomposition (SVD) as top-performing models for this task. Subsequently, we integrated them into the traditional recommender system, encompassing both drug-based collaborative filtering and target-based collaborative filtering, to identify new drug-target associations aligned with observed interactions between drugs and target proteins. Finally, we evaluated the performance of our developed recommender system with matrix factorization for drug-target associations and compared the results with those obtained from a recommender system without matrix factorization.

articleTitle: The Positive Influence of Purchase Intention Factors on Shopee Thai Students in Chiang Mai
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study aims to explain the beneficial factors influencing consumers’ purchasing intentions on Shopee in Chiang Mai, Thailand. The goals of this article are as follows: 1. To study the causal factors that influence intention. This study uses quantitative research methods to obtain a sample group of 265 students who have purchased goods on Shopee and are consumers living in Chiang Mai, Thailand, through quota sampling. The data tool was an online questionnaire. Structural equation modelling was used in the data analysis. Research results found that 1. The developed causal relationship model consists of 7 aspects: 1. perceived value, 2. trust, 3. ease of use, 4. social media, 5. logistics services, 6. promotion, and 7. purchase intention. The model agrees well with the empirical data: $C M I N / D F=0.534, G F I$ $=0.998, C F I=1.00, N F I=0.995, R M S E A=0.00, T I L=1.034$, and $R M R=0.010$, indicating that the variables in the model can explain the positive impact of purchase factors. 2. The trust factor has the most significant positive impact on college students in Chiang Mai, Thailand, purchasing goods on Shopee, followed by 1. logistics services and 2. promotion. Other factors include value perception, ease of use, and social media, which significantly indirectly affect purchase intention through trust. Therefore, Shopee can put trust, logistics services, and promotion as its primary work to obtain more stable young consumers.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Effectiveness of Machine Learning Techniques for the Number of Road Traffic Injuries
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This article aims to compare forecasting techniques with machine learning techniques for predicting the number of people injured in road accidents using data from the Injury Information Collaboration Center, Department of Disease Control, Ministry of Public Health Outpatient Files (OPD) spanning the years 2018 to 2022. The four machine-learning techniques examined in this study include Decision Tree Regression, Random Forest Regression, Support Vector Regression, and Multiple Linear Regression. The data analysis was performed using the R programming language. The results revealed that the Decision Tree Regression technique yielded the most accurate predictions for the number of road traffic injuries, as evidenced by its lowest values of MAE, MSE, and RMSE.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network with CBAM Module for Fitness Activity Recognition Using Wearable IMU Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Wearable motion sensors are gaining traction for fitness activity tracking due to their utility in assisted living, wellness tracking, and fitness training applications. Such sensors typically incorporate accelerometers and gyroscopes to monitor and log physical activities. This work proposes a deep-learning approach for identifying fitness activities using wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) signals. Specifically, a convolutional neural network (CNN) integrated with a convolutional block attention module (CBAM) provides the core framework. The CBAM module applies channel and spatial attention mechanisms to enhance CNN’s capacity to discriminate salient features. Multichannel IMU time-series data, comprising accelerometer and gyroscope readings as subjects perform various exercises, supply input to the model. By learning via an attention-enhanced architecture, the model can extract robust and informative representations to categorize activities accurately. Experiments on a public IMU dataset with five exercise types across over twenty participants evaluated the approach. Results showed over 99.58% subject-independent activity recognition accuracy when augmenting the CNN with CBAM, constituting significant performance gains. The research findings indicate that an efficient deep-learning solution with attention modeling can recognize fitness activities reliably from on-body sensors. The proposed methodology holds substantial promise for applications in sports analytics and personalized health tracking.

articleTitle: Towards Digital Transformation of Vegetable Supply Chains in Developing Economies
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The digitization, digitalization and digital transformation of vegetable supply chains in developing economies has emerged as a promising solution to address the challenges of efficiency, transparency, and information management. This research focuses on the case study of Sri Lanka, a developing economy in Asia, to understand the complexities and information gaps present in its traditional vegetable supply chain. By conducting in-depth interviews and value chain analysis, the study identifies the prevailing digital transformation behaviors among stakeholders, with most falling under the categories of “Paper Masters” and “Digital Migrants,” demonstrating limited digital adoption. To address these challenges and promote digital transformation, a conceptual framework is proposed, involving a data collection platform through a mobile-based application. The platform aims to enhance efficiency, transparency, and decision-making by enabling real-time data collection and sharing among stakeholders. However, the adoption of digital technologies faces obstacles, such as inadequate digital infrastructure, traditional mindsets, financial constraints, and limited digital literacy. Despite these challenges, the study highlights the potential benefits of digital transformation, including optimized resource allocation, increased transparency, and reduced waste in terms of material, financial, and information. Ultimately, the study provides valuable insights for developing economies to embrace digital transformation and build more sustainable and efficient vegetable supply chains for the future.

articleTitle: A Survey Study of ChatGPT Adoption in Northern Thai OTOP Skincare and Herbal Cosmetic
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study examines entrepreneurs’ adoption of AI tools for content creation in Thailand’s One Tambon One Product (OTOP). We evaluated the entrepreneurs’ readiness to incorporate AI tools like ChatGPT in their Social Commerce strategies using a quantitative approach. Our findings discussed under the Technology Acceptance Model reveal a positive inclination toward using ChatGPT for content creation. This research contributes to the discourse on digital adaptation in traditional business models, emphasizing the potential of AI-based ChatGPT to sustain businesses throughout economic adversities. It also opens avenues for further investigation into the strategic implementation and enduring adoption trends of AI tools in S-Commerce.

articleTitle: Relaxation State Assessment on Sleepy Driver through EEG-Based Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: As the prevalence of sleepy driving continues to pose a significant threat to road safety, the need for alternative methods to assess the relaxation state of sleepy drivers becomes necessity. this study presents an alternative approach utilizing Electroencephalography (EEG) data and a synergistic ensemble learning on Neural Networks (NN) and Random Forest (RF) models with hyperparameter tuning. EEG signals, obtained from drivers in simulated or real-world scenarios, capture neurophysiological patterns indicative of relaxation levels. The proposed methodology involves meticulous preprocessing of EEG data to normalize features and split the dataset for training and testing. A Neural Network is designed to capture intricate patterns in the EEG data, while a Random Forest, optimized through hyperparameter tuning, enhances robustness and generalization. Ensemble learning, combining the strengths of both models, provides a comprehensive evaluation of the relaxation state. Results demonstrate the efficacy of the EEG-NN-RF ensemble in accurately assessing drivers’ relaxation states, paving the way for effective monitoring systems and adaptive driver assistance technologies. This research advances proactive measures to mitigate risks associated with sleepy driving, contributing to road safety and accident prevention.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies for Food Loss and Waste in Food Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Food loss and waste (FLW) is a global concern, which can occur in five stages of the food supply chain (FSC) as follows: Farming and Agriculture, Processing and Packaging, Transportation and Storage, Retailing, and Consumption. FLW has a negative impact on the environment, social fabric, and the economy. Moreover, FLW is likely to continue to increase. In order to tackle sustainably problems, various solutions have been introduced. At present, several digital technologies (DTs) have been applied to the FLW management of the FSC. Through this study that involved searching for and analyzing literature on food loss and food waste, it was found that the three most popular DTs are the Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain Technology (BCT), and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), for which are used to track food, to prevent it from being damaged during FSC activities. Then, Big Data Analysis (BDA) can be utilized to collect and analyze data throughout the FSC for accurate shelf-life management. In addition to the development of smart packaging (SPKG) to track food conditions, extend shelf life, and prevent the occurrence of FLW, there is also a Quick Response Code (QR CODE) which applied to provide information to consumers and prevent accidental purchases leading to FLW. The paper presents the benefits of DTs as well as providing guidelines for the management of FLW in the food supply chain.

articleTitle: Identifying Potential Instagram Influencers for E-commerce through a Hybrid Approach of Social Network Analysis and Online Sales Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In the contemporary digital landscape, businesses and brands are amplifying online marketing efforts due to the surge in consumerism. Influencer marketing emerges as a potent strategy, leveraging individuals across diverse online channels. As consumers increasingly rely on social media reviews, influencer marketing seamlessly integrates with the decision-making process. This is evident on platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, where visual content enhances the consumer experience. Despite the ubiquity of influencer marketing, brands face challenges in identifying suitable influencers for their diverse range of products. Similarly, influencers may lack insights into their followers’ online shopping behaviors, impeding their ability to achieve sales goals. To address these challenges, we propose a novel centrality measurement known as the Socio-Behavioral Network Model. This model incorporates two customizable parameters: Online Sale Behavior Measurement and Network Centrality Measurement. By utilizing data from the Instagram network and E-commerce sources, our model generates scores for micro-influencers, specifically targeting the identification of influencers for E-commerce with the potential to drive product sales. In our experiments, the model achieved an output score of $\sim 53 \%$ using Mean Average Precision at K, demonstrating its capability to successfully identify influencers for E-commerce.

articleTitle: How Chinese Travelers Perceive Hotel Room Prices at Different Star Rating Levels From Web Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Perceived prices play a crucial role in hotel operations, garnering attention from both hotel managers and tourists. The primary objective of this study is to determine the relationship between perceived prices and different star-rated hotels. Data was collected through an online survey, and the non-parametric statistical Spearman method was employed. The study reveals a strong positive correlation between star ratings and perceived prices, with varying price differentials across different star-rated hotels. High-star-rated hotels are associated with higher perceived prices, while low-star-rated hotels are perceived as having lower prices. The perception of price differences is more pronounced in high-star-rated hotels, whereas mid to low-star-rated prices are relatively similar. Furthermore, in comparison between actual prices and perceived prices, it is found that the perceived prices for mid to low-star-rated hotels are higher than the actual prices, while high-star-rated hotels’ perceived prices are lower than the actual prices. Lastly, the study conducts a weight analysis of UI components influencing online perceived price evaluations.

articleTitle: Factors exploration Towards Product Selection of Chinese Consumer on the Online Platform
